skiPage.title: Private lessons and guiding
skiPage.subtitle: Ski and snowboard, on-piste and off-piste, across Les Trois Vallées.
skiPage.intro: A French State-certified instructor, I teach ski and snowboard in Courchevel, Méribel, Val Thorens, Les Menuires and Saint-Martin-de-Belleville. Private, family or small-group lessons — from first turns to advanced technique.
skiPage.intro2: It does not have to be a lesson. Many guests simply want guiding: ski at your own pace, discover the area, go off-piste or head out ski touring. The day is built around you.
skiPage.lessonsText: Personalised teaching, all levels. Alpine ski and snowboard. In French, English or Portuguese. Private coaching, away from crowded ski-school groups.
skiPage.guideText: I take you to the finest lines in the massif — scenic pistes or off-piste — with the State diploma as a guarantee of safety. You ski; I take care of the rest.
skiPage.touringText: Beginner introduction or advanced outing. Skins, splitboard, first kick turn or a committed line — according to your level and the weather.
skiPage.pricingNote: Both rates apply to ski / snowboard lessons and to on-piste or off-piste guiding. Lift pass and equipment not included.

faq.q: How much is a private ski lesson in Courchevel?
faq.a: €550 for a half-day (4 h) and €770 for a full day (7 h). The same rates apply in Méribel, Val Thorens and the other Trois Vallées resorts. Lift pass and equipment not included.

faq.q: Does the lesson take place in my resort?
faq.a: We meet in your resort — Courchevel, Méribel, Val Thorens, Les Menuires or Saint-Martin. We start there, then ski across Les Trois Vallées if conditions allow.

faq.q: What equipment do I need?
faq.a: The lift pass and all equipment (skis or snowboard, boots, helmet, etc.) are yours to arrange, rented or your own. They are not included in the lesson price.

faq.q: Can we combine a ski lesson with ski touring?
faq.a: Yes. A day can stay on piste, go off-piste, or become a ski-touring / splitboard outing if conditions allow.

touringPage.title: Beginner or advanced outing
touringPage.subtitle: Ski touring and splitboard in Courchevel, Méribel and Val Thorens — at your pace, in safety.
touringPage.intro: I guide ski-touring and splitboard outings in Les Trois Vallées: first days on skins as well as more committed lines. As a State-certified instructor, I match the itinerary to your level, the weather and the snow.
touringPage.intro2: We start from Courchevel, Méribel or Val Thorens. You do not need to be an expert: that is what the introduction is for. If you already ski off-piste, we look for longer, finer, better-judged days.
touringPage.initiationText: Putting skins on, managing the climb, learning kick turns, preparing the descent. A first guided outing to understand the movement, the pace and the terrain — without putting yourself at risk.
touringPage.advancedText: Longer tours, steeper slopes, route choice according to the bulletin. For skiers and splitboarders already at ease off-piste, who want to go further into the massif.
touringPage.splitText: Transitions, climbing in split mode, riding down. I guide splitboarders as I do ski tourers: the same mountain, another craft, the same standard.
touringPage.gearText: No. I do not provide the kit: skis or splitboard, skins, boots and poles are yours to arrange, usually by rental. I can advise on the choice, according to your level and the outing.
touringPage.gearNote: I always carry a spare airbag pack and an extra avalanche transceiver (ARVA), available if needed.
touringPage.safetyText: Every outing depends on conditions. I choose the itinerary, I read the terrain, I stop if needed. The State diploma covers mountain safety and off-piste — that is the frame for these days.
touringPage.pricingNote: Same rates as lessons and guiding: €550 half-day, €770 full day. Touring equipment and lift pass not included.

faq.q: Do you offer a ski touring introduction?
faq.a: Yes. The introduction covers skins, the climb, kick turns and a suitable descent. Ideal for a first time in Les Trois Vallées.

faq.q: What about splitboard?
faq.a: Yes. Splitboard outings at beginner or advanced level, from Courchevel, Méribel or Val Thorens, according to the day's snow.

faq.q: Do I need off-piste experience?
faq.a: For the introduction, no. For an advanced outing, off-piste ease and decent fitness are needed. We talk it through before booking.

faq.q: Where do the outings take place?
faq.a: In Les Trois Vallées: access from Courchevel, Méribel, Val Thorens, Les Menuires or Saint-Martin-de-Belleville, depending on where you stay and the day's terrain.

faq.q: Is equipment included?
faq.a: No. Touring or splitboard equipment is to be rented on your side. I can advise on the choice, and I always carry a spare airbag pack and an extra avalanche transceiver (ARVA).
